findings.detail: Option A says to resume the session 'in the pipeline', but the stem never mentions a pipeline. In the stem, a developer asks the session directly, so a reader cannot tell at first reading which pipeline is meant. The generating session also goes by several names across the stem, options and reasons: 'the same Claude Code session', 'the generation session', 'the generating session', 'the session that generated the code'.

blind_answer.reason: A session that reviews its own output still carries the reasoning it used to generate the code, so it is less likely to question those decisions. An independent instance without that generation context catches more subtle issues (4.6-K1/K2, 3.6-K4). A and D keep the same biased context. B only changes the output format, not the review quality.
